messages.message: Thanks for calling the clinic. This is the virtual assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi, my name is Priya Raghunathan. I'd like to book a therapy intake appointment, please. I'd prefer to come in person to the Westside clinic on a weekday if possible.
Thanks, Priya. Before I book, I need to verify your identity. Could you give me your date of birth, month, day and year?
My date of birth is September 12, 1996.
I need your last name too, to look up your record. What is your last name?
Thank you, Priya, you're verified. Are you an established patient with Dr. Ramos, or is this your first visit to the clinic?
I'm an existing patient. I've been seen here before, so I'm not new to the clinic.
Thanks for confirming. Let me check openings for an in-person therapy intake at Westside on a weekday.
